title: MANUAL_EVALUATION_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of manual evaluation records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (MANUAL_EVALUATION_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

template_id.description: Identifier of the evaluation template/form used.

meeting_id.description: Observe.ai interaction (meeting) identifier this record relates to.

evaluator_id.description: Observe.ai user identifier for the evaluator.

agent_id.description: Observe.ai user identifier for the agent.

partner_agent_id.description: Partner-system agent identifier(s) linked to the Observe.ai agent.

agent_status.description: Agent account status in Observe.ai (e.g. ACTIVE / IN_ACTIVE).

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the evaluation/session was started.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.

ackInitTime.description: Epoch ms when the agent opened/initiated acknowledgement.

ackTime.description: Epoch ms when the agent acknowledged the evaluation.

comment.description: Agent comment left at acknowledgement time.

ackScoreInfo.description: Score snapshot captured at acknowledgement time.
ackScoreInfo.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputeRaisedById.description: User id who raised the dispute.

disputeRaisedAt.description: Epoch ms when the dispute was raised.

disputedQuestions.description: Question ids/details disputed by the agent.
disputedQuestions.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

raiseDisputeScoreInfo.description: Score snapshot captured when the dispute was raised.
raiseDisputeScoreInfo.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputeSharedWith.description: User ids the dispute was shared with for resolution.
disputeSharedWith.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputeResolvedById.description: User id who resolved the dispute.

disputeResolvedAt.description: Epoch ms when the dispute was resolved.

disputeResolvedQuestions.description: Question ids/details affected by the resolution.
disputeResolvedQuestions.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputeResolvedScoreInfo.description: Score snapshot captured at resolution time.
disputeResolvedScoreInfo.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputePartialResolvedById.description: User id who partially resolved the dispute.

disputePartialResolvedAt.description: Epoch ms when the dispute was partially resolved.

disputePartialResolveComment.description: Resolver comment for the partial resolution.

disputePartialResolvedQuestions.description: Question ids/details affected by the partial resolution.
disputePartialResolvedQuestions.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputePartialResolvedScoreInfo.description: Score snapshot captured at partial-resolution time.
disputePartialResolvedScoreInfo.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

disputeRejectedById.description: User id who rejected the dispute.

disputeRejectedAt.description: Epoch ms when the dispute was rejected.

ack_info.description: Acknowledgement / dispute metadata for this evaluation.

section_score_responses.description: Per-section score breakdown for the evaluation.
section_score_responses.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

questionId.description: Identifier of the evaluation template question.

selectedOption.description: Selected answer option IDs for this question.

items.description: One question answer in this evaluation. Additional fields may be present in your export beyond those listed here.

response.description: Raw evaluator/AI responses captured for the evaluation questions.

result.note: Nested object; additional fields may appear in your export.

obtained_score.description: Total score obtained on the evaluation.

total_score.description: Maximum possible score for the evaluation/template.

calculated_score.description: Computed scoring breakdown for the evaluation.

bonus.description: Bonus points applied to the evaluation score.

penalty.description: Penalty points applied to the evaluation score.

time_took_to_evaluate.description: Time (seconds) taken by the evaluator to complete the evaluation.

date_value.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Used for acknowledgement and dispute timestamps in ack_info.
